package.name: chase_detector
package.description:
YOLO inference on the Tello video stream (chase_msgs/DroneDetection out, both capture and receive stamps on every message), a live viewer with box-centre traces, and a dataset capture node for training the one-class drone detector.
Not expressed below because they are pip packages with no rosdep key: ultralytics (verified 8.4.104) and torch (verified 2.13.0) -- see the detector module docstrings for the exact behaviours relied on.
